package domain

import "time"

const (
	LessonRelationImplementation = "implementation"
	LessonRelationPractice       = "practice"
	LessonRelationComparison     = "comparison"
	LessonRelationReference      = "reference"
	LessonRelationPrerequisite   = "prerequisite"
	LessonRelationContinuation   = "continuation"
	LessonRelationSeeAlso        = "see_also"
)

// LessonRelation is a directed semantic edge between two lessons.
type LessonRelation struct {
	ID                    string    `json:"id"`
	SourceKey             string    `json:"source_key"`
	SourceLessonID        string    `json:"source_lesson_id"`
	SourceLessonSourceKey string    `json:"source_lesson_key"`
	TargetLessonID        string    `json:"target_lesson_id"`
	TargetLessonSourceKey string    `json:"target_lesson_key"`
	Relation              string    `json:"relation"`
	PrimaryStack          *string   `json:"primary_stack,omitempty"`
	Stacks                []string  `json:"stacks"`
	Concepts              []string  `json:"concepts"`
	CreatedAt             time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt             time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}
